notes.title: Small but very overdue patch!
notes.notes:
Game master volume is significantly quieter

lots of sounds that were painfully loud have been decreased

tons of optimization for a now canceled Nintendo switch port

these new optimizations change the core of how a lot of stuff works behind the scenes, but everything should be the same, please let me know if you notice something different

Level pack 1 final boss now pauses the timer when you defeat him so there is no longer the unfair chance of dying at the end

this boss also has some minor tweaks

added an exit sign to the extra levels room to make leaving it more obvious

seriously why did nobody tell me how loud the game was before?

notes.title: MAJOR CONTENT UPDATE
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42047573/dab24cbe7eb94ee37be737b1d7c17eb8b1e6dc51.png

For the anniversary of Robot-X I wanted to do something special, so i worked really hard and cut the deadline very very close, but I have done it!! As this was a big update and i am a solo developer, there is probable a lot of bugs or glitches that I may have missed, please please please create a discussion post going over as much details of any bug you find.

to access any of the new content, you can find it under the extras in the arcade machine!

[previewyoutube=qX00NkYZQBU;full][/previewyoutube]

-lots of minor optimizations                        

-it is more clear when you have charged a shot       

-faster moving platforms in city level 1            

-adjusted volume of loud sound effects and music to be 
 quieter in places where it was too loud              

-4 new levels each with a unique boss               
 plus bonus boss

-2 player competition mode                            

-fixed D-pad in areas where it did not work          

-added lots more steam achievments                   

-smoothed out escape sequences                      

-made first escape more clear and added a
 small cutscene/animation                              

-breaking platforms now work better on 2 player       

-bosses have more hp on 2 player                      

-arrows indicating next area on map screen            

-arcade machine added to end of game so that         
 backtracking is not required to access bonus content

-added 2nd cheat code that brings you to the        
 final boss of challenge mode

-new splash screen                                

-player 2 now has a jump buffer                     

-removed final boss skip                          

-added controller vibration as a setting             
 and camera shake too

-speed run timer is now an option in settings instead of
 a prompt saying to press start on the title screen    

-birthday hat appears on robot-x during november 25    

-Minecart level now progresses the game

notes.title: 1.03.1 baby size patch
notes.notes: I added a little thing on the bottom of the file select screen so that you know what button selects the option your on. "press X to accept" sorta thing

notes.title: 1.03 patch thingy
notes.notes:
this patch fixes 1 known soft lock and multiple other possible soft locks in the challenge mode that would occur by dying at the same time as the boss and teleporting you to the wrong spawn in the next level.

the speed run timer also now shows hours making speedrun.com submissions easier to deal with.

notes.title: 1.02 update patch thingy
notes.notes: In this Update multiple bugs related to the z ordering of sprites has been fixed as well as multiple spelling errors, and the biggest change is a major fix on the final boss, adding better telegraphing as well as better balance as the final boss was too difficult and unfair before, if you run into any issues, make note of them in a discussion or if you can comment on this or something.
